jobs.full_description_text: JOB TITLE Physician, BIPOC Specific LOCATION: Downtown (36B Prince Arthur Ave) & North York (940 Sheppard Ave West), SALARY $335,911.73 ($134,364.69 pro-rated to 0.4 FTE and inclusive of on-call stipend) FTE STATUS: 0.4 FTE REPORTING TO: Director of Community Health Services DURATION OF POSITION: Permanent Planned Parenthood Toronto (PPT) is a fully accredited community health centre that provides primary health care services to youth 13 to 29 years as well as health promotion programming, education, training and research to improve the health and well-being of equity-deserving youth in Toronto. We are currently seeking a racialized Physician to work 15 hours a week. In accordance to PPT’s anti-racist and equity principles, we particularly encourage applications from Black, Indigenous, and/or South Asian communities in order to better reflect the communities of youth we serve and the specific needs of racialized youth. POSITION OVERVIEW The Physician works within an interdisciplinary health care team to independently and collaboratively provide comprehensive primary and episodic health care to clients with an emphasis on sexual & reproductive health, health promotion, disease prevention and health education. The Physician is a member of the Health Services Team and is responsible for supporting the agency's mission, values and objectives. The Physician also functions in accordance with relevant legislation and standards of medical practice. RESPONSIBILITIES • Performs assessment, diagnosis, treatment, health education/counselling and other medical functions as required according to the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario standards of practice. • Provides virtual, over-the-phone and in-person client-centred care. • Manages and supports a client caseload. • Acts as primary liaison and consult with the Nurse Practitioners in assessment, diagnosis and treatment of clients. • Utilizes appropriate referral networks and agencies for clients. • Participates in chart reviews and case conferences. • Able to perform venipuncture and carry out related blood work. • Ensures that laboratory procedural forms are filled out correctly and that specimens are procured and handled properly. • Participates in the Centre’s on call service as directed. • Participates in developing, reviewing, and updating policies and procedures; has specific responsibility for developing medical protocols and procedures. • Provides Standard HIV Point of Care HIV counselling and testing to clients in accordance with the Ministry of Health Policies, Procedures and Quality Assurance for Point-of-Care HIV testing in Ontario. • Provides educational information on IUDs and able to perform IUD insertions and removals. • Provides educational information on the birth control implant and does implant insertions and removals (training can be provided) • Supports trans clients with gender affirming care, including hormone therapy and puberty suppression • Prescribe relevant medications and provide follow up care to clients requesting medical abortions at PPT • Maintains complete and accurate records of client visits including data required by Ontario Health and participates in regular quality of care chart audits and review. • Provides support in the development of Health Services protocols, and collects data and other appropriate administrative tasks as required. • Contributes to the planning and evaluation of Health Services programming and activities. QUALIFICATIONS • Medical degree from a recognized university • Licence to practice medicine and membership in good standing with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario • Three to five years primary care experience; preferably in a community health setting • The successful candidate will be Black, Indigenous and / or a person of colour. • Demonstrated ability to work with youth in areas of sexual and reproductive health, mental health, and gender-affirming care. • Proficiency and experience working with electronic health records an asset. • Demonstrated commitment to equity goals and principles, sexual and reproductive rights and to being youth positive, 2SLGBTQ positive, sex-positive, sex work positive and to being inclusive of diverse sexual and gender identities. • Commitment to pro-choice philosophy • Commitment to working from a community development perspective • Commitment to working cooperatively in a community-based setting as part of an inter-disciplinary team • Excellent written and verbal communication skills • Proficiency and experience working in a computerized environment

jobs.title: Looking For Family Physician with Women's Health Focus
jobs.full_description_text: NEW AND MODERN MEDICAL CENTRE IN THE REGAL HEIGHTS AREA OF TORONTO SEEKING PART TIME FAMILY PHYSICIAN WITH WOMEN'S HEALTH FOCUS NEW GRADS WELCOME Job Title : Family Medicine Physician Location: Toronto, ON Company: Regal Heights Medical Centre About Us: Regal Heights Medical Centre is a brand new medical centre that is physician-owned near Dufferin and St. Clair Ave West, Toronto that opened February 2025. We are dedicated to providing exceptional healthcare services to individuals and families in Regal Heights and all surrounding communities. We offer a wide range of medical services, including family medicine and specialty medicine, pharmacy services, and walk-in all under one roof. Our mission is to deliver personalized, compassionate care in a comfortable, modern and welcoming environment. Position Overview: As a Family Medicine Physician with a focus on Women’s Health, you will play an important role in delivering comprehensive, patient-centred care across the various stages of a woman’s life. The position will have a particular emphasis on preventive women’s health, perimenopause and menopause care, reproductive and sexual health, and age-appropriate screening. You will be supported by an experienced administrative and clinical team to ensure cohesive and seamless clinic operations. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with other physicians, pharmacists, specialists, and allied healthcare professionals to provide coordinated and comprehensive care. This position is well suited to a Family Physician with a particular interest in women’s health who is looking to develop or expand this area of practice within a busy and growing medical centre. Responsibilities: Provide comprehensive primary care with a particular focus on women’s health across the lifespan. Assess and manage perimenopausal and menopausal concerns, including vasomotor symptoms, sleep disturbance, mood changes, genitourinary symptoms, bone health, cardiovascular risk, and discussion of appropriate treatment options. Provide routine women’s health screening and preventive care, including cervical cancer screening, breast cancer screening, osteoporosis risk assessment, cardiovascular risk assessment, and other age-appropriate investigations. Provide reproductive and sexual health care, including contraception counselling, preconception counselling, menstrual concerns, fertility-related concerns, and sexually transmitted infection screening and prevention. Assess and manage common gynecologic concerns, including abnormal uterine bleeding, pelvic pain, vaginal and vulvar symptoms, recurrent urinary concerns, and menstrual irregularities. Provide preventive care, health maintenance, lifestyle counselling, and patient education tailored to women at different stages of life. Diagnose and manage acute and chronic medical conditions within the scope of family medicine. Develop individualized treatment plans in collaboration with patients, incorporating their health goals, preferences, and risk factors. Coordinate referrals and investigations with gynecology, endocrinology, breast imaging, fertility services, osteoporosis clinics, and other specialists as appropriate. Utilize the ACCURO EMR system to document patient encounters, review investigations, and maintain comprehensive medical records. Participate in quality improvement initiatives and adhere to evidence-based clinical guidelines, screening recommendations, and best practices. Qualifications: -Medical degree from an accredited medical school. -Board certification in Family Medicine. -Completion of residency training in Family Medicine. -Valid medical license in Ontario. -Strong clinical skills and knowledge of evidence-based medical practices. -Excellent communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills. -Commitment to providing high-quality, patient-centered care. -Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. -Willingness to participate in continuing medical education and professional development activities. Benefits: -Very competitive overhead offered: 23% (no HST) - Incentive of $5000 sign-on bonus for 1-year term with additional retention bonuses annually. Please inquire for more details. -Opportunity to work in a new, modern medical centre complete with full staff breakroom with coffee and snacks - Opportunity to form a FHG with option to transition to FHO+ -Supportive work environment Regal Heights Medical Centre is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Join us in making a difference in the lives of our patients and community! We look forward to welcoming you to our team at Regal Heights Medical Centre.

jobs.full_description_text: Key information on opportunity : • Virtual appointments only • Schedule is flexible (your choice) • Approximately 5-10 hours/week with opportunity to increase if you desire • No admin work, you just have to document your consultations • Billings: estimated billings up to $400/hour net to you (OHIP) Position Overview : We are looking for an GP Psychotherapist (Must have GP Focused Practice Designation in Psychotherapy by the MOHLTC-OMA committee) with excellent people skills to do depression/anxiety/PTSD consults for our patients. The purpose of these consultations will be to see if the patient is a good candidate for Group Counselling Sessions in mindfulness, CBT, CPT, CBT-i, etc. ( Group Counselling | Institute for Behavioural and Functional Medicine ) We are also looking for the physician to do CBT and/or CPT Group Counselling Sessions with patients. Time commitment : 5-10 hours per month. Opportunity to add more hours will likely be available if interested. Income : • Estimated billings $400/hour net to you (OHIP, no HST charged) Location : Virtual, appointments done over Zoom Healthcare. Hours : flexible Admin : Complete Admin support. No admin work - you just have to complete your notes (Accuro EMR) - several templates to choose from and can help you create your own. Extensive questionnaires are already completed prior to appointments to cut down on charting and we can help you create the ones you would like. Requirements : Licensed to practice medicine in Ontario. Must have GP Focused Practice Designation in Psychotherapy by the MOHLTC-OMA committee and be visible in the OMA directory. About the clinic : Institute for Behavioural & Functional Medicine offers behavioural & lifestyle interventions to help patients retrainng their physiology to correct chronic health problems. We offer patients evidence-based, OHIP-funded rehabilitation programs like CBT-i, CBT for headache, CBT for energy management and more. The first consultation is with the physician to evaluate for a patient's suitability for beginning psychological rehabilitation of their chronic condition. The 2nd appointment is with the GP Psychotherapist to prepare for the OHIP funded counselling. Learn more about this rapidly expanding field at ibfmed.ca .

jobs.full_description_text: NEW AND MODERN MEDICAL CENTRE IN THE REGAL HEIGHTS AREA OF TORONTO SEEKING PART TIME / FULL-TIME FAMILY PHYSICIAN WITH WOMEN'S HEALTH FOCUS NEW GRADS WELCOME Job Title : Family Medicine Physician Location: Toronto, ON Company: Regal Heights Medical Centre About Us: Regal Heights Medical Centre is a brand new medical centre that is physician-owned near Dufferin and St. Clair Ave West, Toronto that opened February 2025. We are dedicated to providing exceptional healthcare services to individuals and families in Regal Heights and all surrounding communities. We offer a wide range of medical services, including family medicine and specialty medicine, pharmacy services, and walk-in all under one roof. Our mission is to deliver personalized, compassionate care in a comfortable, modern and welcoming environment. Position Overview: As a Family Medicine Physician with a focus on Women’s Health, you will play an important role in delivering comprehensive, patient-centred care across the various stages of a woman’s life. The position will have a particular emphasis on preventive women’s health, perimenopause and menopause care, reproductive and sexual health, and age-appropriate screening. You will be supported by an experienced administrative and clinical team to ensure cohesive and seamless clinic operations. You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with other physicians, pharmacists, specialists, and allied healthcare professionals to provide coordinated and comprehensive care. This position is well suited to a Family Physician with a particular interest in women’s health who is looking to develop or expand this area of practice within a busy and growing medical centre. Responsibilities: Provide comprehensive primary care with a particular focus on women’s health across the lifespan. Assess and manage perimenopausal and menopausal concerns, including vasomotor symptoms, sleep disturbance, mood changes, genitourinary symptoms, bone health, cardiovascular risk, and discussion of appropriate treatment options. Provide routine women’s health screening and preventive care, including cervical cancer screening, breast cancer screening, osteoporosis risk assessment, cardiovascular risk assessment, and other age-appropriate investigations. Provide reproductive and sexual health care, including contraception counselling, preconception counselling, menstrual concerns, fertility-related concerns, and sexually transmitted infection screening and prevention. Assess and manage common gynecologic concerns, including abnormal uterine bleeding, pelvic pain, vaginal and vulvar symptoms, recurrent urinary concerns, and menstrual irregularities. Provide preventive care, health maintenance, lifestyle counselling, and patient education tailored to women at different stages of life. Diagnose and manage acute and chronic medical conditions within the scope of family medicine. Develop individualized treatment plans in collaboration with patients, incorporating their health goals, preferences, and risk factors. Coordinate referrals and investigations with gynecology, endocrinology, breast imaging, fertility services, osteoporosis clinics, and other specialists as appropriate. Utilize the ACCURO EMR system to document patient encounters, review investigations, and maintain comprehensive medical records. Participate in quality improvement initiatives and adhere to evidence-based clinical guidelines, screening recommendations, and best practices. Qualifications: -Medical degree from an accredited medical school. -Board certification in Family Medicine. -Completion of residency training in Family Medicine. -Valid medical license in Ontario. -Strong clinical skills and knowledge of evidence-based medical practices. -Excellent communication, interpersonal, and teamwork skills. -Commitment to providing high-quality, patient-centered care. -Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative environment. -Willingness to participate in continuing medical education and professional development activities. Benefits: -Very competitive overhead offered: 23% (no HST) - Incentive of $5000 sign-on bonus for 1-year term with additional retention bonuses annually. Please inquire for more details. -Opportunity to work in a new, modern medical centre complete with full staff breakroom with coffee and snacks - Opportunity to form a FHG with option to transition to FHO+ -Supportive work environment Regal Heights Medical Centre is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applicants from diverse backgrounds. We thank all applicants for their interest; however, only those selected for an interview will be contacted. Join us in making a difference in the lives of our patients and community! We look forward to welcoming you to our team at Regal Heights Medical Centre.

jobs.title: Physician, Cancer-Related Fatigue Clinic
jobs.full_description_text: Why This Clinic Exists Fatigue is the most commonly reported symptom in cancer and the one most likely to go untreated. Patients raise it, are told it is normal, and leave with nothing. We built Cancer Fatigue Services because that gap should not exist. CFS is Canada’s first physician-led, multidisciplinary practice dedicated entirely to cancer-related fatigue. Comprehensive medical assessment, cardiopulmonary exercise testing, supervised rehabilitation, and structured physician-led counselling, delivered as one coordinated longitudinal pathway. Why We Are Speaking to You Cancer-related fatigue is a differential diagnosis problem, and that is your discipline. Anemia. Thyroid dysfunction. Hypogonadism. Adrenal insufficiency. Sleep-disordered breathing. Treatment-related cardiotoxicity. Medication burden. Deconditioning. Mood. Any of them can produce profound exhaustion in a survivor, several are usually operating at once, and someone has to work through the list. Almost nobody does, which is why these patients arrive years after treatment ended having been told their bloodwork is fine. The physiology is measured, not estimated. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing at baseline and reassessment gives you integrated cardiac, pulmonary, and metabolic data on a symptom assessed almost everywhere else by questionnaire. Late treatment effects are an expanding clinical problem. Cardiovascular, pulmonary, endocrine sequelae, and metabolic consequences of long-term therapy are all growing as survival improves. There is room to build genuine expertise here. It is ambulatory and scheduled. No ward service, no consult pager, no call, no weekends. The Role Conduct comprehensive fatigue assessments covering presentation, oncologic and treatment history, symptom characterization, and functional status. Lead results delivery encounters and build the shared care plan with the patient and the team. Deliver the structured counselling encounters that anchor the care model. Session materials, scripts, workbooks, and documentation templates are built and in active use. Provide medical oversight to the rehabilitation and psychosocial teams. Coordinate ongoing care with referring oncologists, primary care providers, and other specialists. We Do Healthcare Differently We treat patients better by carrying the burden of navigating the system instead of handing it back to them. We treat clinicians the same way. High volumes with no downtime are how care quality erodes and how good physicians burn out, so we have built the clinic around concrete commitments: Administrative support, human and technological, so your attention stays on the patient. Fifteen to sixty minutes of team support attached to every encounter. Administrative time scheduled into your day, not appended to it. A buffer between encounters, set to your preference. You set your own schedule. We ask only for consistency week to week. No call, no after-hours coverage, no inpatient responsibility. Leave your work at work. We have built the clinic so that is actually possible. Terms Compensation: You keep 65% on comprehensive assessments and 70% on every other encounter type. Commitment: Our physicians work anywhere from three full days to two half-days per week. No minimum. Delivery: First OHIP-covered encounter on-site, most follow-ups virtual. Qualifications MD or equivalent, active and unrestricted CPSO licence, CMPA coverage, OHIP billing number. Demonstrated diagnostic skill with complex, multi-system presentations. Strong communication skills, particularly in conversations about function, loss, and expectation setting. Comfort in a multidisciplinary team and with structured, templated documentation. Assets: FRCPC in Internal Medicine, or a subspecialty background in cardiology, respirology, endocrinology, geriatrics, or physical medicine and rehabilitation. Experience interpreting cardiopulmonary exercise testing. Interest in clinical research.

raw_json_ld.description: Why This Clinic Exists Fatigue is the most commonly reported symptom in cancer and the one most likely to go untreated. Patients raise it, are told it is normal, and leave with nothing. We built Cancer Fatigue Services because that gap should not exist. CFS is Canada’s first physician-led, multidisciplinary practice dedicated entirely to cancer-related fatigue. Comprehensive medical assessment, cardiopulmonary exercise testing, supervised rehabilitation, and structured physician-led counselling, delivered as one coordinated longitudinal pathway. Why We Are Speaking to You Cancer-related fatigue is a differential diagnosis problem, and that is your discipline. Anemia. Thyroid dysfunction. Hypogonadism. Adrenal insufficiency. Sleep-disordered breathing. Treatment-related cardiotoxicity. Medication burden. Deconditioning. Mood. Any of them can produce profound exhaustion in a survivor, several are usually operating at once, and someone has to work through the list. Almost nobody does, which is why these patients arrive years after treatment ended having been told their bloodwork is fine. The physiology is measured, not estimated. Cardiopulmonary exercise testing at baseline and reassessment gives you integrated cardiac, pulmonary, and metabolic data on a symptom assessed almost everywhere else by questionnaire. Late treatment effects are an expanding clinical problem. Cardiovascular, pulmonary, endocrine sequelae, and metabolic consequences of long-term therapy are all growing as survival improves. There is room to build genuine expertise here. It is ambulatory and scheduled. No ward service, no consult pager, no call, no weekends. The Role Conduct comprehensive fatigue assessments covering presentation, oncologic and treatment history, symptom characterization, and functional status. Lead results delivery encounters and build the shared care plan with the patient and the team. Deliver the structured counselling encounters that anchor the care model. Session materials, scripts, workbooks, and documentation templates are built and in active use. Provide medical oversight to the rehabilitation and psychosocial teams. Coordinate ongoing care with referring oncologists, primary care providers, and other specialists. We Do Healthcare Differently We treat patients better by carrying the burden of navigating the system instead of handing it back to them. We treat clinicians the same way. High volumes with no downtime are how care quality erodes and how good physicians burn out, so we have built the clinic around concrete commitments: Administrative support, human and technological, so your attention stays on the patient. Fifteen to sixty minutes of team support attached to every encounter. Administrative time scheduled into your day, not appended to it. A buffer between encounters, set to your preference. You set your own schedule. We ask only for consistency week to week. No call, no after-hours coverage, no inpatient responsibility. Leave your work at work. We have built the clinic so that is actually possible. Terms Compensation: You keep 65% on comprehensive assessments and 70% on every other encounter type. Commitment: Our physicians work anywhere from three full days to two half-days per week. No minimum. Delivery: First OHIP-covered encounter on-site, most follow-ups virtual. Qualifications MD or equivalent, active and unrestricted CPSO licence, CMPA coverage, OHIP billing number. Demonstrated diagnostic skill with complex, multi-system presentations. Strong communication skills, particularly in conversations about function, loss, and expectation setting. Comfort in a multidisciplinary team and with structured, templated documentation. Assets: FRCPC in Internal Medicine, or a subspecialty background in cardiology, respirology, endocrinology, geriatrics, or physical medicine and rehabilitation. Experience interpreting cardiopulmonary exercise testing. Interest in clinical research.

The Division of Clinical and Metabolic Genetics has a long tradition of excellence in clinical care, education, and innovative research. Independent and collaborative clinical and basic research is performed by Division members. The successful candidate will join a dynamic interprofessional care team. The successful candidate will provide care for clinical genetics patients in the outpatient settings and inpatient consultation service. Specific interest and expertise in methylation disorders, overgrowth and mechanisms of imprinting is preferred but not required. Evidence of excellence in teaching and research is required. Candidates at all career stages are encouraged to apply. All candidates must be able to function proficiently in English, hold an MD, MBBS or equivalent thereto and be certified or eligible for certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or have comparable qualifications. Candidates must hold or be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario. This position will remain open until filled. The successful candidate will be eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto. Rank and salary ($275,543 to $340,000) per annum will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The successful candidate will be eligible for a benefits package which includes medical, dental, life insurance, long term disability insurance, group insurance, pension plan, vision care, academic allowance, and a relocation package. jobs.title: Dentist-in-Chief – Department of Paediatric Dentistry
jobs.full_description_text: The Department of Paediatric Dentistry at The Hospital for Sick Children (SickKids), Faculty of Dentistry, University of Toronto, is inviting applications for the position of Dentist-in-Chief. This is a full-time role for an academic paediatric dentist and leader in paediatric oral health. The effective date of this appointment is June 2027 but can be negotiated. Primary Description Responsibilities include full clinical practice, research, and education, and administrative responsibilities as required by a Department Chief. Evidence of excellence in teaching and research is required. This role reports directly to the Chief of Peri-Operative Services. Additional Description The successful candidate should be a senior academic with an international reputation who can provide effective and collaborative leadership and vision at the hospital, provincial, national and international levels. The candidate must be eligible for appointment at the rank of Associate Professor at the University of Toronto and be eligible for certification with the Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario. Candidates must obtain an appropriate Visa, if applicable. We are seeking an individual whose leadership qualifications include management proficiency, dispute resolution, communications expertise, mentoring capabilities, the ability to engender trust, function collaboratively with all manner of clinical teams and administration. Additionally, the successful candidate will have a long-term vision for the Department which integrates with the mission of Peri-Operative Services, the Hospital and the University of Toronto. Salary will be in the range of $200,000 to $400,000 for 40 hours per week, commensurate with qualifications and experience, and which will be supplemented by clinical billing activity. Benefits include Medical, Dental, Life, Group Insurance, Pension, Vision. A per annum stipend, in recognition of the administrative leadership responsibilities associated with the Department Chief role, will be provided. Support for relocation expenses will be offered. The position has a potential duration of two terms of five years each. Department Description The Department of Paediatric Dentistry at The Hospital for Sick Children consist of 18 dental surgeons, orthodontists and paediatric dentists, provides dental care for children and adolescents under 18 years whose treatment is best managed in a multidisciplinary hospital environment. It is integral to the Ontario Cleft Lip and Palate Craniofacial Dental program and is a major clinical training and research centre for the University of Toronto Graduate Paediatric Dentistry program. The Department also provides training to hospital staff, community dentists, physicians and families through affiliation with the University of Toronto. Hospital Description SickKids, located at 555 University Avenue in downtown Toronto, is among the largest children’s hospitals in North America and has a long history of excellence in clinical care, research and education. It was named the number one paediatric hospital in the world in 2025, by Newsweek magazine. SickKids is fully affiliated with the University of Toronto and is located adjacent to the University campus and to numerous specialty hospitals and biomedical research institutes. Toronto is a vibrant and multicultural city, widely recognized as one of the most diverse cities in the world, with approximately half of its residents born outside Canada and representation from more than 250 ethnicities. This diversity is reflected in the city’s neighbourhoods, food scene, Michelin-starred restaurants across Toronto and the surrounding region, and strengths in key sectors such as life sciences, finance, information, and communications technology. As one of the largest cities in North America, Toronto offers a dynamic downtown, diverse neighbourhoods, strong schools, and access to leading universities. It is regularly recognized in global city, travel, and liveability rankings. World-famous lake and wilderness country and year-round outdoor recreation are easily accessible, as are two hub airports for regional and international travel. Kulkarni Chief, Peri-Operative Services and Chair of the Search Committee 175 Elizabeth St, Toronto, ON M5G 2G3 EMAIL: dentistrydepartmentchief.recruitment@sickkids.ca All qualified candidates are encouraged to apply; however, Canadians and permanent residents will be given priority. We value applicants who have demonstrated a commitment to equity, diversity and inclusion and recognize that diverse perspectives, experiences, and expertise are essential to strengthening our academic mission. Our values regarding equity and diversity are linked with our unwavering commitment to excellence in the pursuit of our academic mission. The University is committed to the principles of the Accessibility for Ontarians with Disabilities Act (AODA). jobs.title: Division Head, Haematology Oncology
jobs.full_description_text: Join our team and be part of our bold new strategy for Precision Child Health, advancing discovery, prevention, and treatment for children worldwide. The Division of Haematology Oncology provides diagnostic services and specialist care for children and adolescents with cancer (paediatric oncology) and nonmalignant blood diseases (paediatric haematology), as well as those receiving haematopoietic stem cell transplantation and cellular therapies. The Division of Hematology Oncology is seeking a full-time permanent faculty position as Division Head, Haematology Oncology at the Hospital for Sick Children, 555 University Ave., Toronto, ON, which is an academic health science centre dedicated to the care of children affiliated with the Temerty Faculty of Medicine at the University of Toronto. The Division offers a comprehensive subspecialty residency /fellowship program, attracting Canadian and international trainees to our Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada-accredited program in Paediatric Haematology-Oncology. There are also specialized fellowships offered across the division ranging from early phase trials and neuro-oncology to cancer genetics, late effects/survivorship, and stem cell transplantation/cellular therapy. Our interprofessional team provides comprehensive care and services across 5 sections (haematology, stem cell transplant/cellular therapies, leukemia/lymphoma, solid tumour, and neuro-oncology). Specialized multi-disciplinary programs include New Agents and Innovative Therapies (NAIT), Cancer Genetics, Long Term Follow-up, Bone Marrow Failure, Haemoglobinopathies and Thrombosis. We are actively involved in clinical, translational, and basic science research related to blood disorders and cancer in children, with a focus on designing and participating in prospective clinical trials and delivering precision therapies to patients locally, provincially, and nationally. The successful candidate will lead and mentor our diverse faculty and trainees, collaborate with allied health and nursing partners, and innovate with our scientists at the Research Institute. By championing clinical services, education, and research, you will advance our cancer and haematology programs and align academic activities with the Temerty Faculty of Medicine at the University of Toronto. The successful candidate will provide care in both inpatient and ambulatory settings within the Division of Haematology-Oncology. This role supports the expansion of specialized clinical services and offers opportunities for creative and professional activities, as well as translational and basic research to improve evidence-based care. As Division Head, you will also serve as a strategic advisor and steward of philanthropic funds, influencing the Division's vision and serving as Head of the Garron Family Cancer Centre (GFCC). The GFCC enhances and integrates clinical, research, and educational activities to improve outcomes for children, adolescents, and young adults with cancer. The successful candidate must possess leadership and mentoring experience, with a demonstrated track record in academic and research excellence. The successful candidate will be eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto. Rank and salary ($425,000-$525,000) per annum will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. The successful candidate may also be eligible for a leadership stipend. The successful candidate will be eligible for a benefits package which includes medical, dental, life insurance, long term disability insurance, group insurance, pension plan, vision care, academic allowance, and relocation package and support services. All candidates must be able to function proficiently in English, hold an MD, MBBS or equivalent thereto and be certified or eligible for certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or have comparable qualifications. Candidates must hold or be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario. This position will remain open until filled. Interested individuals should submit a letter of interest, curriculum vitae including a statement of research, education and clinical contribution, and names and addresses of three references to Dr. Meredith Irwin, Professor and Chair, Department of Paediatrics, The Hospital for Sick Children, 555 University Avenue, Toronto, Ontario Canada M5G 1X8: e-mail sarah.isbester@sickkids.ca The Department is strongly committed to diversity within its community and especially welcomes applications from racialized person/persons of colour, women, Indigenous / Aboriginal People of North America, persons with disabilities, LGBTQ persons, and others who may contribute to the further diversification of ideas. The Department recognizes and fairly considers the impact of leaves (e.g., family care or health-related) that may contribute to career interruptions or slowdowns. Candidates are encouraged to signal any leave that affected productivity, or that may have influenced their career path. This information will be considered to ensure the equitable assessment of the candidate’s record. The Department further supports an employment equity program and encourages members of designated equity groups to self-identify. It further seeks to ensure equitable treatment and full inclusion of persons with disabilities. Persons with disabilities who anticipate needing accommodations for any part of the application process may contact, in confidence, sarah.isbester@sickkids.ca

jobs.title: Consultant Pediatrician – Locum Opportunity
jobs.full_description_text: Consultant Pediatrician – Locum Opportunity (Toronto, Ontario) We are seeking a Consultant Pediatrician to provide parental leave coverage from October 2026 to October 2027, with the opportunity to remain on as an associate following the locum period, if desired. This is an excellent opportunity to join a modern, well-established community practice with a strong referral base and the flexibility to build a practice that aligns with your professional interests. What we offer: Modern, clean, and bright clinical space Supportive, collegial, multidisciplinary environment including family medicine, subspecialty medicine, mental health, and allied health professionals Full-service administrative support Advanced technology including OSCAR Pro EMR, Ocean eReferrals, and AI scribe tools Established referral network that can support a busy practice from day one Flexible scheduling with the ability to set your own hours Extremely competitive income split Free parking and easy access via public transit Practice Profile The current practice is a 100% consultative pediatric practice with a mix of medical, developmental, and mental health consultations. Follow-up care is provided at the discretion of the consultant pediatrician. For physicians interested in continuing beyond the locum period, there is an opportunity to remain as an associate and further develop the practice based on individual interests, including focused areas of pediatrics, developmental care, mental health, or primary care services. Located in the vibrant Mimico community of Toronto, this opportunity combines professional flexibility, strong clinical support, and immediate access to a well-established patient base. Requirements: Board certification in Pediatrics CPSO license in Pediatrics Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with medical teams. Commitment to delivering high-quality, patient-centered care. Why Mimico Medical? Physician-owned and operated. State-of-the-art medical facilities with advanced technology. Supportive work environment prioritizing physician quality of life. Opportunities for professional growth and autonomy. Full management support from an experienced team. Competitive compensation and billing support. About Us Mimico Medical is a growing multidisciplinary medical clinic proudly serving the Etobicoke community with comprehensive, patient-centered healthcare. Our team includes 9 Family Physicians operating under the FHO+ care model , supported by a robust internal referral network and allied health services, including Psychiatry, Psychotherapy, Physiotherapy, Pediatrics, Women's Health, and other specialty clinics. As we continue to expand our services, we are committed to improving access to high-quality, collaborative care for our patients.

Our diverse team of general pediatricians, pediatric subspecialists, mental health practitioners and allied health care providers work together to provide comprehensive and collaborative care. - Work in the office and/or virtually. You choose. - Our virtual-care model allows doctors to augment with casual, part-time, or full-time work. - Cloud-based, HIPAA/PHIPA compliant EMR with VPN access from home. - Chart, bill, order labs/imaging/write sick notes/referrals and discharge notes from anywhere you want! - Guaranteed patient volume depending on preference. - ZERO EMR fee. - Competitive overhead rate. - Overhead is tax-deductible as an associate (versus an employee at other clinics). - Commitment is casual or long-term. jobs.title: Staff Echocardiographer Cardiologist
jobs.full_description_text: Staff Paediatric Cardiologist Effective immediately The Division of Cardiology at The Hospital for Sick Children, Department of Paediatrics (555 University Ave. Toronto, M5G 1X9), an academic health science centre dedicated exclusively to children, affiliated with the University of Toronto, is seeking a full-time permanent faculty position for a staff paediatric cardiologist with sub-specialty training in Echocardiography at the Labatt Family Heart Centre – Cardiology Division. Candidates with expertise in Fetal Cardiology or Pulmonary Hypertension would be of special interest. The Labatt Family Heart Centre brings together significant interdisciplinary and inter-professional activities within Paediatric Cardiology, Cardiovascular (CV) Surgery, Cardiac Critical Care, Cardiovascular Research and Adult Congenital Heart Disease Programs, thus allowing the Heart Centre to address the needs of patients and families from fetal life to adulthood. The Heart Centre at The Hospital for Sick Children promotes these activities through seamless integration of research activities, academic performance, and exemplary clinical care. The primary role of the successful candidate will be to focus on providing excellence in clinical care, education, and research in the field of Echocardiography. The successful candidate will also be expected to teach our fellows and undertake innovative and impactful research. We anticipate some requirement for additional service provision in other subspecialty areas, including general inpatient and outpatient cardiology, depending on the candidate’s experience and interests. The successful applicant would ideally have completed subspecialty training and/or specific clinical experience in echocardiography and fetal cardiology and will report to the Division Head, Labatt Family Heart Centre. The successful candidate must be able to function proficiently in English, hold an MD, MBBS or the equivalent thereto and be certified or eligible for certification by the Royal College of Physicians and Surgeons of Canada or have comparable qualifications. Candidates must hold or be eligible for licensure with the College of Physicians and Surgeons of Ontario. The successful candidate must be eligible for an academic appointment at the University of Toronto. Rank and salary ($300,000-$450,000) per annum and will be commensurate with qualifications and experience. Applications should include a cover letter, curriculum vitae and a statement outlining current and future clinical and research interests. In addition, provide names and addresses of three references to Dr. Mike Seed, Head, Division of Cardiology, Department of Paediatrics, Hospital for Sick Children 555 University Avenue, Toronto, Ontario, Canada M5G 1X8 email: mike.seed@sickkids.ca For additional information regarding the Department of Paediatrics see http://www.sickkids.ca/paediatrics/ . The University of Toronto and The Hospital for Sick Children are strongly committed to diversity within its community. Both institutions recognize systemic barriers that impact equity seeking groups. As such, we welcome applications from historically marginalized groups including Black, Indigenous, and Racialized people, women, LGBTQIA+, and/or persons with disabilities. The Department recognizes and fairly considers the impact of leaves (e.g., family care or health-related) that may contribute to career interruptions or slowdowns. Candidates are encouraged to signal any leave that affected productivity, or that may have influenced their career path. This information will be considered to ensure the equitable assessment of the candidate’s record. The Department further supports an employment equity program and encourages members of designated equity groups to self-identify. It further seeks to ensure equitable treatment and full inclusion of persons with disabilities. Persons with disabilities who anticipate needing accommodations for any part of the application process may contact, in confidence, Anna Capizzano, r at meagan.cameira@sickkids.ca or 416.613.6122. All qualified applicants are encouraged to apply; however, in accordance with Canadian immigration requirements, Canadians and permanent residents will be given priority. Only those applicants selected for the interview will be contacted.

jobs.full_description_text: Part-Time Psychiatrist – (Virtual Consultations) Flexible Remote Opportunity | Competitive Compensation Hybrid of OHIP + Stipend Our outpatient community Rapid Access Addiction Medicine (RAAM) clinic is actively seeking a psychiatrist to join our team on a part-time, virtual basis. This is an ideal opportunity for a psychiatrist who wants to fit meaningful, well-compensated clinical work into an existing schedule. We offer the flexibility to choose when to see patients . Since most patients are admitted to a residential treatment facility, consults can fit throughout your day (e.g., during a no-show to your regular practice), ensuring no lost income during your workday. Your scope will be limited to the psychiatric assessment and treatment of patients engaged in a formal addiction treatment program. All patients are managed collaboratively with our team of Addiction Medicine Physicians, counselors, and psychotherapists in a high-quality, patient-centred environment . We offer treatment for persons using all kinds of substances. Our services include medication, counseling, art groups, affordable psychotherapy, harm reduction supplies, and more. Contact us at admin@ctctoronto.com or 647-490-4008 for more information. Website: http://www.ctctoronto.com
